claims.claim: Food for about 2,000 civilians still in Russian-occupied Oleshky and surrounding villages had run out.

claims.source_title: ‘Hell on earth’: last residents eat weeds to survive in Russian-occupied Oleshky
claims.supporting_quote: food for the 2,000 or so civilians still remaining in the city and its surrounding villages had finally run out.

claims.claim: A woman in Oleshky wrote that her weight had fallen from 110 kilograms to 67.
claims.episode_span: her weight had fallen from 110 kilograms to 67
claims.source_title: ‘Hell on earth’: last residents eat weeds to survive in Russian-occupied Oleshky
claims.supporting_quote: Before the war, she weighed 110kg (17 stone); now she weighs just 67, she wrote.

claims.claim: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha accused Russia of starving residents of Oleshky and of being the only obstacle to evacuation.
claims.episode_span: accused Russia of starving residents, and called Russia the only obstacle to evacuation
claims.source_title: ‘Hell on earth’: last residents eat weeds to survive in Russian-occupied Oleshky
claims.supporting_quote: Sybiha warned of a “humanitarian catastrophe” and called for an immediate evacuation, accusing Russia of standing as “the only obstacle”.

claims.claim: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov acknowledged a critical situation in Oleshky and accused Ukrainian forces of blocking humanitarian supplies.
claims.episode_span: Dmitry Peskov acknowledged a critical situation but accused Ukrainian forces of blocking humanitarian supplies
claims.source_title: ‘Hell on earth’: last residents eat weeds to survive in Russian-occupied Oleshky
claims.supporting_quote: The Kremlin spokesperson, Dmitry Peskov, this month acknowledged the “critical situation” in Oleshky but accused Ukrainian forces of blocking humanitarian supplies intended for its residents.

claims.claim: Food supplies to Oleshky halted after May as Russian forces expanded minefields and drone cover, and Russian troops have taken civilians' saved food after Ukrainian drone strikes on supply lines.
claims.episode_span: Supplies that still arrived until May have stopped as Russian forces expanded minefields and drone cover
claims.source_title: ‘Hell on earth’: last residents eat weeds to survive in Russian-occupied Oleshky
claims.supporting_quote: But since May, as the occupying Russian forces expanded minefields and drone cover, the trickle of supplies has entirely halted.

claims.claim: At least 27 people were killed in two mass shootings in South Africa hours apart.
claims.episode_span: at least 27 people were killed in two mass shootings
claims.source_title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead
claims.supporting_quote: The two attacks hours apart come as the country struggles to stop high levels of gang-related armed violence.

claims.episode_span: a house-party shooting near Durban killed 11 people, including a pregnant woman

claims.supporting_quote: The two shootings come just days after a mass shooting at a house party near the east coast city of Durban killed 11 people, including a pregnant woman.

claims.claim: Bangkok declared a disaster after nearly 4,900 people were evacuated and about 52,000 households were affected.
claims.episode_span: floods sent nearly 4,900 people to shelters and affected about 52,000 households
claims.source_title: Bangkok floods force thousands into shelters as disaster declared
claims.supporting_quote: Nearly 4,900 people have been evacuated to shelters, with about 52,000 households affected by the floods, which prompted a disaster declaration across the capital, according to the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA).

claims.claim: More than 330 millimetres of rain fell in some parts of Bangkok between Thursday and Sunday.
claims.episode_span: More than 330 millimetres of rain fell in some areas between Thursday and Sunday.
claims.source_title: Bangkok floods force thousands into shelters as disaster declared
claims.supporting_quote: More than 330mm of rain fell in some areas of the city between Thursday and Sunday, the weather agency said.

claims.episode_span: his house along the Premprachakorn canal was under water for about 30 hours
claims.source_title: Bangkok floods force thousands into shelters as disaster declared
claims.supporting_quote: “Our house was under water for about 30 hours,” office worker Kosin Nilset, who lives along the Premprachakorn canal on the outskirts of the capital, said on Sunday morning.

claims.claim: Governor Chadchart Sittipunt said about 1,000 people were evacuated to a school shelter and warned residents to avoid unnecessary travel, with rain forecast to taper from Monday.
claims.episode_span: said about 1,000 people were at one school shelter in Kheha Romklao
claims.source_title: Bangkok floods force thousands into shelters as disaster declared
claims.supporting_quote: Chadchart visited a temporary shelter on Saturday night in a school in the Kheha Romklao area, where he said about 1,000 people were evacuated.

claims.claim: British police evacuated homes near RAF Fairford and arrested several men on suspicion of explosives offences.
claims.episode_span: police evacuated homes on Sunday near RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire
claims.source_title: UK police make arrests, evacuate homes in ‘major incident’ near air base used by US forces
claims.supporting_quote: British police said they had evacuated homes Sunday near the air base of Fairford in southwest England used by US air forces and arrested several men over suspected explosives offenses.

claims.claim: Fairford has been used by the United States to launch operations against Iran.
claims.episode_span: the base has been used by the United States to launch operations against Iran
claims.source_title: UK police make arrests, evacuate homes in ‘major incident’ near air base used by US forces
claims.supporting_quote: Fairford, in ⁠Gloucestershire, has been used by the US to launch operations against Iran.

claims.claim: Police said they believed the situation at the military base was contained.
claims.episode_span: said they believed the situation was contained
claims.source_title: UK: Several arrested as bomb disposal team examines vehicles
claims.supporting_quote: Several men were arrested on suspicion of explosives offences, while police said they believed the situation was contained.

claims.claim: Army bomb disposal experts were examining vehicles near the air base.
claims.episode_span: Army bomb disposal experts were examining a number of vehicles.
claims.source_title: U.K. police evacuate homes near U.S. air base and detain men on suspected explosives offensives
claims.supporting_quote: British police said on Sunday they had arrested several men on suspicion of explosives offences and Army bomb disposal experts were examining a number of vehicles in a "major incident" near an air base used by the U.S. in southwest England.

claims.claim: Maharashtra declared drought in 265 of 358 talukas after an 18.8 percent rainfall deficit, with 755.9 millimetres from June to September 18.
claims.episode_span: declared drought in 265 of the state's 358 talukas
claims.source_title: Maharashtra declares drought in 265 talukas
claims.supporting_quote: Maharashtra Government on Saturday (September 26, 2026) issued a government resolution (GR) declaring drought in 265 of the State’s 358 talukas based on the Agriculture Commissioner’s report, following prolonged rainfall deficits causing crop loss in the State.

claims.claim: The drought order activates 12 immediate reliefs after a dry spell of at least 21 days, and a cabinet subcommittee under Chandrashekhar Bawankule is overseeing relief.
claims.episode_span: The order activates 12 immediate reliefs, among them a land-revenue waiver
claims.source_title: Maharashtra declares drought in 265 talukas
claims.supporting_quote: The GR facilitates the assessment of crop loss and activates 12 immediate reliefs, including a land revenue waiver, crop loan restructuring, a stay on farm loan recovery, an exemption from agri-pump electricity bills, a school exam fee waiver, relaxation of MNREGA work requirements, drinking water tankers, a ban on pump disconnections, and food grain and fodder security.

claims.source_title: Israeli minister Bezalel Smotrich calls for war in occupied West Bank

claims.claim: CBC reported the Palestinian death toll in the Gaza war above 74,000, and said Israel's military described continued strikes as responses to threats or attacks.
claims.episode_span: CBC puts the death toll above 74,000, and Israel's military says continued strikes were responses to threats or attacks
claims.source_title: Palestinian death toll in Gaza war rises above 74,000 since war began
claims.supporting_quote: While a ceasefire that took effect last Oct. 10 has halted the heaviest fighting, Israeli strikes have continued in what the military has said are responses to threats or attacks.

claims.claim: Brazil's debt buyout and related measures come to as much as about 8.2 billion US dollars, mostly in 2027 and not in the 2027 budget bill.

claims.supporting_quote: Brazil’s new plan to buy old household debts, with a betting ban and a Bolsa Família rise, comes to as much as R$42.3 billion (about US$8.2 billion) in costs and lost revenue, mostly in 2027, none of it in the 2027 budget bill.

claims.episode_span: from 360 baboons to 493, in 12 managed troops
claims.source_title: ‘It’s hard to sell a house when it’s covered in baboon faeces’: Cape Town divided over plan to remove its monkeys
